Overview

Jinan is a city in Shandong with a population of 9,200,000. Capital of Shandong province, famous for its artesian springs, willow trees, and role as a cultural and educational center. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
